_note: v0.56.0 (plan v0.56.0-repeater-icons-date D1–D7, M5) SSR contract datetime-picker@1 (ADR 0012 / 0025): td_datetime_picker() / td_date() always print the element <td-datetime-picker data-td-ssr="datetime-picker@1"> > div.td-dtp > [label.td-field__label for={id}-native] + input.td-dtp__native (type date | datetime-local, name, value, min / max — the picker's default year domain 2000–2099 when no bound —, step, required, disabled: works without JS) + button.td-dtp__trigger (SIBLING of the native input, hidden until defined) + [div.td-field__note] + [span.td-field-error]. The element adopts it through its OWN gate (the live native value wins over the attribute, the native input is removed after the host's FormData is set). Shared by test/php/td-v056-php.test.js (PHP output, fixture freshness) and src/form/td-datetime-picker.ssr.engines.browser-test.js (Chromium / Firefox / WebKit, via test/ssr/fixtures/datetime-picker.html — GENERATED by `node test/ssr/build-datetime-picker-fixture.mjs`). `quiet`: the call warns on purpose (E_USER_WARNING silenced in the fixture). `expect`: the adopted element (host value attribute, submitted entry).
